name: assessment-week
title: Assessment office this week
subtitle: Read-only working view. Review the evidence before making a decision.

sections.title: Assessment readiness
sections.sql: select code,name,due_date,questions,question_gaps,missing_marks from assessment_readiness order by due_date

sections.title: Results awaiting review
sections.sql: select code,assessment,participant,percent,moderation from result_board where moderation<>'accepted' order by code

sections.title: Overdue follow-up
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_date from actions where status='open' and due_date<current_date order by due_date

sections.title: Recorded checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,record

sections.title: Validation plan
sections.sql: select code,name,due_date,decision,risk_note from validation_status order by due_date

sections.title: Topic coverage
sections.sql: select assessment,topic,min_marks,available_marks,missing_marks from blueprint_coverage order by assessment,topic
